description: This file contains unit tests for the PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory class, validating its behavior in parsing and resolving string parameters and placeholders, with specific tests for single and multiple parameter scenarios.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of PipelineFunctionParameterResolverFactory related to string and placeholder parameter parsing.

methods.name: singleStringResolverAcceptsDoubleQuotes
methods.description: Tests that a string parameter with double quotes is correctly resolved and contains the expected value.

methods.name: singleStringResolverAcceptsSingleQuotes
methods.description: Tests that a string parameter with single quotes is correctly resolved and contains the expected value.

methods.name: singleResolverThrowsExceptionOnMultipleParameters
methods.description: Ensures that providing multiple parameters results in a PlaceholderFunctionSignatureInvalidException.

methods.name: singleResolverResolvesPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies that placeholders are resolved correctly to their expected value.

methods.name: singleResolverAllowsWhitespaceInStrings
methods.description: Checks that extra whitespace within string parameters does not affect resolution.

methods.name: singleResolverAllowsWhitespaceBetweenParentheses
methods.description: Tests that whitespace around parentheses and within parameters does not interfere with resolution.

methods.name: singlePlaceholderResolverReturnsPlaceholderIfNotResolvable
methods.description: Confirms that unresolved placeholders return an empty optional.

methods.name: singleStringResolverThrowsExceptionIfNotResolvable
methods.description: Verifies that unresolved placeholders trigger an exception when using string-only resolvers.

methods.name: singleStringResolverDoesNotResolvePlaceholders
methods.description: Ensures that string resolvers do not resolve placeholders but only literal strings.

methods.name: emptyParameterResolverResolvesEmptyParentheses
methods.description: Checks that empty parentheses are recognized as valid empty parameters.

methods.name: emptyParameterResolverFailsForNonEmptyParentheses
methods.description: Ensures non-empty parentheses are not falsely recognized as empty parameters.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverAcceptsThreeDoubleQuotedStringParameters
methods.description: Tests parsing of three double-quoted string parameters.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverAcceptsMixOfDoubleQuotedAndSingleQuotedStringParameters
methods.description: Verifies parsing of a mix of double and single-quoted string parameters.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverAcceptsMixOfDoubleQuotedAndSingleQuotedStringParametersAndPlaceholders
methods.description: Tests parsing a mix of strings and placeholders with resolution.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverFailsIfLessParametersAreGiven
methods.description: Confirms that fewer than three parameters result in an exception.

methods.name: tripleParameterResolverFailsIfMoreParametersAreGiven
methods.description: Confirms that more than three parameters result in an exception.
